clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked away behind towering cliffs in northeastern Winterspring, the Hidden Grove is a secluded crater basin. Once an untroubled haven for Arctic hares, the basin has fallen under the domain of fiercely territorial wild moonkin.

Walled off from the bitter howling winds of Winterspring, the Hidden Grove forms a sunken, snow-dusted forest crater that is nearly impossible to access from the outside cliffs. Travelers who discover its concealed rim must brave a sheer, dangerous drop or navigate a narrow cavern passage tucked into the southeastern ridge. Though the valley was long the undisturbed home of harmless white hares, aggressive wild moonkin have seized the glade, turning an isolated natural paradise into an ambush for unwary wanderers.
